subject: shiny server: using a non-standard R installation

messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: shiny server: using a non-standard R installation
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to use the shiny server with an R that I built from source and did not install in /usr/local. It was actually built by the shiny user (who I have set up as a regular user, not a system user) and lives in ~shiny/R.

How can I tell shiny server to use a particular R, one which may not be in the PATH?

I'd like the shiny server on this particular machine not to interfere with other R installations on the machine.

Thanks
Dan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny server: using a non-standard R installation
parts:
You can set the "R" environment variable for the Shiny Server process. (Or alternatively, alter your PATH for that process.)

If this doesn't work, let me know--I can't say we have extensively tested this.
